text: If any of your apps don't work in MacOS Mojave, a small tweak in your settings might fix the problem (AAPL) By Dave Smith Oct 28, 2018, 9:00 am 30 pts I have an old version of Adobe Photoshop I've kept on my laptop for many years now — it's CS5, for those of you keeping score.
